items.text: — rebuilt from current codebase: customizable menubar/UI, accent colors, thresholds, ⌘Q quit.
— OpenAI + OpenRouter only (bring your own keys).
— Lab, Dev Mode, and Experimental toys stay on Beta/Experimental.
— App ZIP recommended; PKG/DMG/.sh also available.
— thermal forecast, heat haiku, throttle cosplay, overnight watch, core roulette, chaos blip.
— duel, ghost-load, SOC budget, cloak, peer, AirDrop card, widget, confession, alibi, presets.
— shared build with Experimental; no new Lab toys on Beta (toys stay Experimental-only).
— menubar density, slot reorder, accent color, section toggles, color thresholds, left-click popover vs window — no Dev Mode required.
— optional advanced sampling, verbose logs, sensor dump, JSON snapshot, Developer settings tab.
— slim Lab, full AI providers, Advisor, Cleaner. ⌘Q quit fix retained.
— chopstickshq.com hub; full product site at getrnitro.netlify.app.
— releases on github.com/ilikemacos/rNitro with App ZIP, PKG, DMG, and .sh.

releases.title: v1.2.0 Final (Stable)
releases.body_html: Stable catch-up — customizable UI + ⌘Q from modern builds; OpenAI/OpenRouter only; no Lab. GitHub.

releases.title: v1.2.6 Experimental
releases.body_html: New Lab toys — thermal forecast, heat haiku, throttle cosplay, overnight watch, core roulette, chaos blip. Beta keeps slim Lab.

releases.title: v1.2.5 Beta / Experimental
releases.body_html: Customizable UI + Developer Mode — menubar builder, density, accents, thresholds for everyone; optional Dev tools for sampling/logs/dumps. GitHub.

releases.title: v1.2.4 Beta / Experimental
releases.body_html: Patched a bug — ⌘Q now quits the menu bar app. Lab crash fix (scrub slider) + Experimental Features sidebar.

releases.title: v1.2.3 Beta
releases.body_html: Beta — Lab: AirDrop card, SOC budget, cooling confession, desktop widget, rnitro lab status.

releases.title: v1.1.0 Final Reloaded
releases.body_html: Stable channel — production-ready menu bar monitor for daily use. AI limited to OpenAI + OpenRouter.

releases.title: Platform notes
releases.body_html: macOS — Apple Silicon, macOS 12+. Linux — v0.1 pre-release. Windows — deprecated.
